name: Lins (Brazil)
description: Divided by a cross and saltire into eight triangles alternately red and blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms reading EX COFFEA AC SCHOLA LINS.
history: Lins is a municipality in the state of São Paulo, Brazil. Flags of the World records that the flag, designed by the Coats of Arms Commission of Campinas at the request of the municipal council, was prescribed by a municipal law of 13 April 1970; the law describes it as square, but it is drawn and used rectangular. The arms date from Municipal Law No. 281 of 17 December 1953.
